user.title: Solarman V5 data logger
user.description: A Solarman V5 data logging stick bridging the inverter's RS485 port. It answers on port 8899 with Modbus RTU inside its own V5 frames, not with Modbus TCP.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the data logger.
data_description.unit_id: Slave address of the inverter. Usually 1.
data_description.logger_serial: Leave empty to learn it from the logger's first answer.

error.cannot_connect: The inverter did not answer. Check the address, the wiring, and that it is powered and producing.
error.invalid_serial: The data logger serial must be a number. Leave it empty to detect it automatically.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: The inverter needs several seconds per answer, so keep this well above 10 seconds.
